title: Quick-fix pipeline stuck: all worktree slots blocked by orphans

chat.text: The whole quick-fix pipeline (and anything else needing a worktree) is stuck site-wide: all 9 qf-N slots are blocked. qf-1/qf-3 have dead unmerged branches with no worktree dir; qf-2/4/5/7/8 are real worktrees on disk with uncommitted/unmerged work that Servex's own registry has lost track of; qf-6/qf-9 are legitimately taken. A Servex restart already happened and didn't fix it, because adopt() only reconciles its own state file and never scans `git worktree list` for orphans. This blocked a real bug fix (duplicate chat-line rendering) from landing. Needs careful manual triage per worktree — salvage or merge any real work before removing — not a blind cleanup. Routing to whoever owns Servex infra; this affects every session on the machine, not just this one.
